##### Project General Facts

Palace Residences Dubai Hills Estate embodies the essence of refined luxury, standing as a masterpiece of upscale living within the esteemed Dubai Hills Estate. This extraordinary development boasts the distinction of being the first branded residential apartments in this prestigious locale, setting a new standard for opulent living. Upon entering this realm, residents are enveloped in an atmosphere of unbridled luxury, where every aspect is meticulously crafted to surpass the expectations of even the most discerning individuals.

The amenities within Palace Residences Dubai Hills Estate are a testament to the development's unwavering commitment to excellence, featuring an expansive lap pool that serves as a serene oasis, perfect for unwinding after a day's pursuits. Additionally, the playful splash pads offer a realm of joy and entertainment for younger residents, creating unforgettable memories that will be treasured for a lifetime. The residences themselves boast an array of options, ranging from cozy one-bedroom abodes to spacious three-bedroom dwellings, each equipped with fully fitted kitchens that elevate the culinary experience to unparalleled heights.

The interiors of Palace Residences Dubai Hills Estate exude modern sophistication, characterized by modern finishing with high-quality materials. The fully fitted kitchens are a haven for culinary enthusiasts, providing an ideal space to craft exquisite meals. With a focus on comfort, luxury, and refined living, every detail within these residences is carefully considered to provide a life of unwavering elegance and poise.


##### Location description and benefits

Dubai Hills is a pinnacle of luxury living, boasting an array of attractions and conveniences that cater to the most discerning individuals. The stunning eighteen-hole championship golf course, designed to international standards, adds a touch of serenity and natural beauty to the landscape, attracting golf enthusiasts from around the world. The Dubai Hills Mall, a world-class shopping and entertainment center, offers a diverse array of retail, dining, and entertainment options, ensuring that every need is catered to.

The natural beauty of Dubai Hills is further enhanced by the presence of Central Park, a vast expanse of greenery and relaxation that provides a serene escape from the hustle and bustle of city life. This harmonious blend of luxury living, natural beauty, and modern urban design creates a truly unique lifestyle experience. The community is developed by Emaar Properties in collaboration with Meraas Holding, bringing together the expertise of two renowned entities to craft a masterpiece of urban design.

The prestige and vibrancy of Dubai Hills are palpable, with its stunning golf course, world-class shopping, and expansive parklands creating a lifestyle destination that is unparalleled in its sophistication and allure. The development's master-planned design ensures a seamless blend of luxury living, natural beauty, and modern urban convenience, making it an ideal destination for those seeking a life of refined elegance and poise. With its array of attractions and conveniences, Dubai Hills is a true gem in the heart of Dubai, United Arab Emirates.
